name: Edelweiss Lounge
kurzbeschreibung:
Welcome to the **Edelweiss Lounge** in **Tirol**—where alpine charm meets modern comfort. Nestled in the heart of the **Zillertal** or just a short stroll from **Innsbruck**, this cozy retreat invites you to unwind after a day of adventure. Sip on a **Schnaps** or a creamy **Kaiserschmarrn** latte while soaking in breathtaking views of the **Nordkette** or the **Karwendel** mountains. Whether you're here for skiing, hiking, or simply escaping the hustle, the **Edelweiss Lounge** offers the perfect blend of relaxation and local flair. Come experience **Tirol**’s warmth—one sip, one bite, and one unforgettable moment at a time. --- **

Highlights

** - **Handcrafted cocktails** with alpine herbs - **Homemade pastries** (try the **Topfenstrudel**!) - **Live music** on select evenings - **Sunset views** from our terrace --- **
